tests.name: staging gateway is up on the deployed build (phase 1 keeps staging dispatching via the override)

tests.reason: The loop gate is an env decision with no HTTP surface, and firing a reminder writes to real members' rows in the shared database, so no suite may trigger one. The Jest gate matrix pins prod-on / staging-needs-override / audiobook kill switch and both workflows' pins. Read-only after deploy: oasis_events reminder.* keep arriving with env=staging after phase 1 (override true), and with env=production after PUBLISH.
